invariants: The target stable tag must remain an ancestor of the candidate.
Every personal commit must survive the rebase; an empty or dropped personal commit stops promotion.
Existing personal tests may not be removed, disabled, weakened, or converted into unconditional skips.
Base cmux behavior may not be deleted or bypassed merely to make the personal feature compile.
The syntax-highlighting feature and its user-facing setting must remain functional.
Updater, signing, entitlement, release, and workflow conflicts require human review.
